installCommand: CARGO_HOME=/root/.cargo RUSTUP_HOME=/root/.rustup curl -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs|sh -s -y --default-toolchain nightly-2025-01-07 &&. /root/.cargo/env && curl -sSf https://rustwasm.github.io/wasm-pack/installer/init.sh|sh && cargo install just
buildCommand: . /root/.cargo/env && corepack enable && just build && yarn install && (cd packages/web-wallet && yarn build)
